paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Immutable paper trade-family identifier.
Immutable execution-leg identifier.
Point-in-time instrument symbol captured for the trade.
caveats: Symbol lineage may change; immutable trade ID remains authoritative.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Instrument market and asset classification.
BUY is long/buy-then-sell; SELL is short/sell-first-then-buy.
Point-in-time entry rule used for this paper trade.
Versioned parent strategy identifier.
Canonical trade-leg open timestamp displayed in IST.
caveats: Canonical storage timezone is preserved; display is IST.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Quantity-weighted paper fill entry price.
Quantity opened when the paper trade filled; normally derived from the recorded F&O lot.
caveats: Cash-equity price is used; quantity remains the historical F&O-derived quantity.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Quantity still open after governed exits.
Cash-equity entry price multiplied by the captured F&O-derived quantity.
Whole shares purchasable with ₹2 lakh at entry.
caveats: Uninvested cash is retained separately.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Whole-share quantity multiplied by entry price.
Governed closed-fill P&L after modelled costs and tax provision.
Governed closed-fill P&L before costs and tax provision.
Current gross mark-to-market for remaining execution quantity.
caveats: Exit costs are not yet recognised.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Latest accepted position mark and timestamp.
Counterfactual result at the final canonical entry-session one-minute close.
Seven favourable target tracks with explicit eligibility, hit, miss and open states.
paperTradingCanonicalFields.capitalBasis: Per share plus captured and fixed-capital values
caveats: An observed hit is not an execution close unless the governed rule says so.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Inclusive entry-to-five-session evidence that freezes at maturity.
paperTradingCanonicalFields.formulaOrSource: horizon_outcomes horizon_sessions=5; current carry until complete
caveats: Developing and frozen values have different maturity states.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Inclusive D0–D+30 evidence; continues after the five-session path freezes.
paperTradingCanonicalFields.formulaOrSource: horizon_outcomes horizon_sessions=30; current carry until complete
caveats: The first five sessions are included, not a separate additive horizon.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Trading sessions observed versus the required horizon.
caveats: Calendar days and trading sessions are distinct.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Largest direction-normalised favourable return through five sessions.
caveats: Not necessarily executable at the extreme.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Deepest direction-normalised adverse return through five sessions.
Largest direction-normalised favourable path in the inclusive D0–D+30 window.
caveats: Not necessarily executable at the extreme.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Deepest direction-normalised adverse path in the inclusive D0–D+30 window.
caveats: Trade MAE is not portfolio drawdown.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Counterfactual P&L from entry to latest accepted quote using the original quantity.
caveats: Ignores governed exits and hypothetical exit costs.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Gross counterfactual exit at first gap-aware one-minute breach.
paperTradingCanonicalFields.formulaOrSource: stop price plus first qualifying bars_1m breach
caveats: Hypothetical exit costs excluded.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Actual return divided by observed favourable excursion.
caveats: Observed MFE is not necessarily executable.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Versioned weighted process/outcome score with hard-risk override.
caveats: Not a recommendation.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Private persisted operational notes with author and timestamp.
caveats: Omitted from non-admin responses.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Ordered execution and analytical event history.
Workspace/source timestamps, maturity, missing inputs and current incidents.
caveats: Fresh transport does not prove analytical readiness.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: O/X, RSI, ATR, Williams and relative-volume values captured at or before entry.
caveats: Future outcomes are labels and never entry features.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Chronological allocation scenarios for ₹1L, ₹2L, ₹5L and ₹10L per trade.
paperTradingCanonicalFields.eligibility: Source trade passes the selected entry-strategy ledger
caveats: Not paper-account equity; strategies never share capital.

paperTradingCanonicalFields.definition: Counterfactual first-hit exit outcomes under versioned intraday/swing target pairs.
paperTradingCanonicalFields.timeBasis: First matching hit or latest mark
paperTradingCanonicalFields.eligibility: All source trades; hit or open outcome
caveats: Does not replace actual governed execution.
